456	    def checkout_cart_batch(self, checkouts):
457	        # All-or-nothing batch checkout: every entry is normalized, every cart
458	        # and target order id is checked, and every cart is priced against the
459	        # current catalog before any order is created. Managed stock uses the
460	        # margin left after every existing reservation; the combined demand of
461	        # all carts for one sku must fit it, so a shortfall anywhere (including
462	        # the last entry) rejects the whole request: carts, orders, inventory,
463	        # history and sequences stay byte-for-byte untouched and the data
464	        # directory is never created.
465	        if not isinstance(checkouts, list) or not checkouts:
466	            raise ValueError("checkouts must be a nonempty list")
467	        entries = []
468	        seen_carts = set()
469	        seen_orders = set()
470	        for item in checkouts:
471	            if not isinstance(item, dict):
472	                raise ValueError("each checkout must be an object with cart_id and order_id")
473	            cart_id = text(item.get("cart_id"), "cart_id")
474	            order_id = text(item.get("order_id"), "order_id")
475	            if cart_id in seen_carts:
476	                raise ValueError("duplicate cart_id: " + cart_id)
477	            seen_carts.add(cart_id)
478	            if order_id in seen_orders:
479	                raise ValueError("duplicate order_id: " + order_id)
480	            seen_orders.add(order_id)
481	            entries.append((cart_id, order_id))
482	        data = self._read()
483	        carts = data.get("carts", {})
484	        orders = data.get("orders", {})
485	        products = data.get("products", {})
486	        # Resolve every cart and target id and price every line against the
487	        # current catalog before any mutation; merge the combined demand so a
488	        # shared product is checked against the batch total.
489	        planned = []
490	        combined = {}
491	        for cart_id, order_id in entries:
492	            cart = carts.get(cart_id)
493	            if cart is None:
494	                raise ValueError("unknown cart: " + cart_id)
495	            if order_id in orders:
496	                raise ValueError("order already exists")
497	            needed = {}
498	            for line in cart["lines"]:
499	                sku = line["sku"]
500	                product = products.get(sku)
501	                if product is None:
502	                    raise ValueError("unknown product: " + sku)
503	                if not self._is_enabled(product):
504	                    raise ValueError("product is not available for sale: " + sku)
505	                needed[sku] = needed.get(sku, 0) + line["quantity"]
506	            planned.append((cart_id, order_id, needed))
507	            for sku, quantity in needed.items():
508	                combined[sku] = combined.get(sku, 0) + quantity
509	        inventory = data.get("inventory", {})
510	        # Unmanaged products never constrain the batch; managed demand must fit
511	        # the availability left after every existing reservation.
512	        for sku in sorted(combined):
513	            entry = inventory.get(sku)
514	            if entry is not None and combined[sku] > entry["on_hand"] - entry["reserved"]:
515	                raise ValueError("insufficient stock: " + sku)
516	        # All checks passed: place in request order on the same in-memory
517	        # document. Each _place reserves against the reservations earlier
518	        # checkouts in this batch just added, so shared-product stock snapshots
519	        # chain; the combined check above guarantees none of them can fail.
520	        created = []
521	        for cart_id, order_id, needed in planned:
522	            order = self._place(
523	                data, order_id,
524	                [{"sku": sku, "quantity": needed[sku]} for sku in sorted(needed)],
525	            )
526	            created.append(order)
527	            carts.pop(cart_id, None)
528	        self._write(data)
529	        return sorted(created, key=lambda order: order["order_id"])

531	    def amend(self, order_id, lines):
532	        order_id = text(order_id, "order_id")
533	        if not isinstance(lines, list) or not lines:
534	            raise ValueError("lines must be a nonempty list")
535	        requested = []
536	        needed = {}
537	        for line in lines:
538	            if not isinstance(line, dict):
539	                raise ValueError("each line must be an object with sku and quantity")
540	            sku = text(line.get("sku"), "sku")
541	            quantity = positive(line.get("quantity"), "quantity")
542	            requested.append((sku, quantity))
543	            needed[sku] = needed.get(sku, 0) + quantity
544	        data = self._read()
545	        order = data.get("orders", {}).get(order_id)
546	        if order is None:
547	            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + order_id)
548	        if order["status"] != "placed":
549	            raise ValueError("only a placed order can be amended")
550	        # Paused products may stay in an order, shrink or disappear, but no new
551	        # paused SKU can be added and its merged total may never grow. Compare
552	        # current ordered quantities against the merged new list -- never
553	        # history or actual reservations.
554	        current = {}
555	        for line in order["lines"]:
556	            current[line["sku"]] = current.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
557	        products = data.get("products", {})
558	        items = []
559	        for sku, quantity in requested:
560	            product = products.get(sku)
561	            if product is None:
562	                raise ValueError("unknown product: " + sku)
563	            if not self._is_enabled(product) and (
564	                sku not in current or needed[sku] > current[sku]
565	            ):
566	                raise ValueError("product is not available for sale: " + sku)
567	            items.append({"sku": sku, "quantity": quantity, "unit_price_cents": product["price_cents"], "subtotal_cents": quantity * product["price_cents"]})
568	        inventory = data.get("inventory", {})
569	        own = data.get("reservations", {}).get(order_id, {})
570	        # New demand may use what is available plus what this order already
571	        # holds; orders without reservation records get no extra allowance.
572	        reservations = {}
573	        for sku, quantity in needed.items():
574	            entry = inventory.get(sku)
575	            if entry is None:
576	                continue
577	            if quantity > entry["on_hand"] - entry["reserved"] + own.get(sku, 0):
578	                raise ValueError("insufficient stock: " + sku)
579	            reservations[sku] = quantity
580	        # Validate everything before touching inventory, so a rejected amend
581	        # leaves stock, reservations and history untouched. Stock history sees
582	        # only the final net change per sku, never the temporary release and
583	        # re-reservation below.
584	        affected = sorted(sku for sku in set(own) | set(reservations) if inventory.get(sku) is not None)
585	        before_views = {sku: self._stock_view(sku, inventory[sku]) for sku in affected}
586	        for sku, quantity in own.items():
587	            entry = inventory.get(sku)
588	            if entry is not None:
589	                entry["reserved"] -= quantity
590	        if reservations:
591	            for sku, quantity in reservations.items():
592	                inventory[sku]["reserved"] += quantity
593	            data.setdefault("reservations", {})[order_id] = reservations
594	        else:
595	            data.get("reservations", {}).pop(order_id, None)
596	        for sku in affected:
597	            after = self._stock_view(sku, inventory[sku])
598	            if after != before_views[sku]:
599	                self._record_stock_event(data, sku, "amend", order_id, before_views[sku], after)
600	        order["lines"] = items
601	        order["total_cents"] = sum(x["subtotal_cents"] for x in items)
602	        self._record_event(data, order_id, "amend", order, False)
603	        self._write(data)
604	        return order

606	    def reduce_order(self, order_id, lines):
607	        # Reduce a placed order while keeping the deal: surviving rows keep
608	        # their original relative order and per-row deal unit prices; for each
609	        # sku the reduction is taken from the LAST row backwards, zero rows are
610	        # removed and surviving duplicate rows are never merged. Subtotals are
611	        # recomputed at the preserved prices. Paused sales, catalog-less
612	        # products and insufficient stock never block a reduction; whole-order
613	        # cancellation still goes through cancel. The order's own reservation
614	        # for an involved managed product becomes min(old reservation, merged
615	        # remaining quantity) -- only the difference is released, total
616	        # reserved drops and availability rises by the same amount, on_hand,
617	        # other orders and uninvolved products never change. Missing inventory
618	        # or reservation records read as no reservation (never auto-managed or
619	        # topped up); a reservation driven to zero loses its attribution key.
620	        order_id = text(order_id, "order_id")
621	        if not isinstance(lines, list) or not lines:
622	            raise ValueError("lines must be a nonempty list")
623	        requested = {}
624	        for line in lines:
625	            if not isinstance(line, dict):
626	                raise ValueError("each line must be an object with sku and quantity")
627	            sku = text(line.get("sku"), "sku")
628	            quantity = positive(line.get("quantity"), "quantity")
629	            requested[sku] = requested.get(sku, 0) + quantity
630	        data = self._read()
631	        order = data.get("orders", {}).get(order_id)
632	        if order is None:
633	            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + order_id)
634	        if order["status"] != "placed":
635	            raise ValueError("only a placed order can be reduced")
636	        current = {}
637	        for line in order["lines"]:
638	            current[line["sku"]] = current.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
639	        remaining_total = {}
640	        for sku, quantity in requested.items():
641	            if sku not in current:
642	                raise ValueError("sku not in order: " + sku)
643	            if quantity > current[sku]:
644	                raise ValueError("reduced quantity exceeds ordered quantity: " + sku)
645	            remaining_total[sku] = current[sku] - quantity
646	        # Reducing every line away is a cancellation and is rejected here.
647	        if sum(current[sku] - requested.get(sku, 0) for sku in current) == 0:
648	            raise ValueError("cannot reduce the whole order; cancel it instead")
649	        # Take each sku's reduction from its last row first by walking the
650	        # rows backwards, then restore the original relative order. Deal unit
651	        # prices travel with their rows and subtotals are recomputed at them;
652	        # zero-quantity rows disappear and surviving duplicates stay split.
653	        deduct = dict(requested)
654	        survivors_reversed = []
655	        for line in reversed(order["lines"]):
656	            sku = line["sku"]
657	            removed = min(line["quantity"], deduct.get(sku, 0))
658	            deduct[sku] = deduct.get(sku, 0) - removed
659	            quantity = line["quantity"] - removed
660	            if quantity:
661	                unit_price = line["unit_price_cents"]
662	                survivors_reversed.append({
663	                    "sku": sku,
664	                    "quantity": quantity,
665	                    "unit_price_cents": unit_price,
666	                    "subtotal_cents": quantity * unit_price,
667	                })
668	        items = list(reversed(survivors_reversed))
669	        inventory = data.get("inventory", {})
670	        own = data.get("reservations", {}).get(order_id, {})
671	        # Plan every reservation change before mutating inventory, so a
672	        # rejection leaves stock, reservations and history untouched. Only
673	        # managed products hold reservations; a missing inventory record reads
674	        # as no reservation even if a stray attribution key exists.
675	        plan = []
676	        for sku in requested:
677	            entry = inventory.get(sku)
678	            if entry is None:
679	                continue
680	            old = own.get(sku, 0)
681	            new = min(old, remaining_total[sku])
682	            if new != old:
683	                plan.append((sku, old, new))
684	        before_views = {sku: self._stock_view(sku, inventory[sku]) for sku, _, _ in plan}
685	        record = data.get("reservations", {}).get(order_id)
686	        for sku, old, new in sorted(plan):
687	            inventory[sku]["reserved"] -= old - new
688	            if new:
689	                record[sku] = new
690	            else:
691	                record.pop(sku, None)
692	            self._record_stock_event(
693	                data, sku, "reduce-order", order_id,
694	                before_views[sku], self._stock_view(sku, inventory[sku]),
695	            )
696	        if record is not None and not record:
697	            # The order held no other reservations: drop its attribution.
698	            data.get("reservations", {}).pop(order_id, None)
699	        order["lines"] = items
700	        order["total_cents"] = sum(x["subtotal_cents"] for x in items)
701	        self._record_event(data, order_id, "reduce-order", order, False)
702	        self._write(data)
703	        return order

705	    def reserve_order(self, order_id):
706	        # Top up reservations for a placed order whose products became managed
707	        # after it was placed. Deal lines, prices, amounts and status are never
708	        # touched, and paused sales never block the top-up.
709	        order_id = text(order_id, "order_id")
710	        data = self._read()
711	        order = data.get("orders", {}).get(order_id)
712	        if order is None:
713	            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + order_id)
714	        if order["status"] != "placed":
715	            raise ValueError("only a placed order can be reserved")
716	        needed = {}
717	        for line in order["lines"]:
718	            needed[line["sku"]] = needed.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
719	        products = data.get("products", {})
720	        inventory = data.get("inventory", {})
721	        own = data.get("reservations", {}).get(order_id, {})
722	        # Validate every sku and compute every addition against the current
723	        # availability before touching any inventory entry, so a rejected
724	        # top-up leaves stock, reservations and history untouched. A missing
725	        # reservation record reads as zero.
726	        additions = {}
727	        for sku in sorted(needed):
728	            if sku not in products:
729	                raise ValueError("unknown product: " + sku)
730	            entry = inventory.get(sku)
731	            if entry is None:
732	                # Unmanaged products stay unlimited and are never auto-managed.
733	                continue
734	            added = max(0, needed[sku] - own.get(sku, 0))
735	            if added > entry["on_hand"] - entry["reserved"]:
736	                raise ValueError("insufficient stock: " + sku)
737	            if added:
738	                additions[sku] = added
739	        lines = []
740	        for sku in sorted(needed):
741	            if inventory.get(sku) is None:
742	                lines.append({"sku": sku, "quantity": needed[sku], "added": 0, "reserved": 0})
743	            else:
744	                added = additions.get(sku, 0)
745	                lines.append({
746	                    "sku": sku,
747	                    "quantity": needed[sku],
748	                    "added": added,
749	                    "reserved": own.get(sku, 0) + added,
750	                })
751	        result = {"order_id": order_id, "lines": lines}
752	        if not additions:
753	            # Nothing to add: the result is still returned, but no file is
754	            # written and no events are appended.
755	            return result
756	        for sku in sorted(additions):
757	            entry = inventory[sku]
758	            before = self._stock_view(sku, entry)
759	            entry["reserved"] += additions[sku]
760	            self._record_stock_event(data, sku, "reserve-order", order_id, before, self._stock_view(sku, entry))
761	        reservations = data.setdefault("reservations", {}).setdefault(order_id, {})
762	        for sku, added in additions.items():
763	            reservations[sku] = reservations.get(sku, 0) + added
764	        self._record_event(data, order_id, "reserve-order", result, False)
765	        self._write(data)
766	        return result

768	    def reserve_batch(self, order_ids):
769	        # Priority batch top-up: orders are processed in the given order
770	        # (input order is the priority); each order either gets its full new
771	        # demand or is skipped whole and consumes nothing, and later orders
772	        # keep being processed. The whole request is validated before any
773	        # mutation, so a rejected batch leaves data, history and sequences
774	        # untouched and never creates the data directory.
775	        if not isinstance(order_ids, list) or not order_ids:
776	            raise ValueError("order_ids must be a nonempty list")
777	        selected = []
778	        seen = set()
779	        for order_id in order_ids:
780	            order_id = text(order_id, "order_id")
781	            if order_id in seen:

789	        all_reservations = data.get("reservations", {})
790	        # Merge duplicate sku lines inside each order first; the whole request
791	        # is rejected if any selected order is missing, no longer placed, or
792	        # carries a product outside the current catalog.
793	        demanded = {}  # order_id -> {sku: merged quantity}
794	        for order_id in selected:
795	            order = orders.get(order_id)
796	            if order is None:
797	                raise ValueError("unknown order: " + order_id)

875	    def transfer_reservation(self, source_id, target_id, lines):
876	        # Move reservations between two placed orders: the source gives up
877	        # quantities it actually holds and the target receives them, never
878	        # touching on_hand, total reserved, availability, other orders, status,
879	        # deal lines, prices or amounts. Paused sales never block a transfer.
880	        source_id = text(source_id, "source_id")
881	        target_id = text(target_id, "target_id")
882	        if not isinstance(lines, list) or not lines:
883	            raise ValueError("lines must be a nonempty list")
884	        requested = {}
885	        for line in lines:
886	            if not isinstance(line, dict):
887	                raise ValueError("each line must be an object with sku and quantity")
888	            sku = text(line.get("sku"), "sku")
889	            quantity = positive(line.get("quantity"), "quantity")
890	            requested[sku] = requested.get(sku, 0) + quantity
891	        data = self._read()
892	        orders = data.get("orders", {})
893	        source = orders.get(source_id)
894	        if source is None:
895	            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + source_id)
896	        target = orders.get(target_id)
897	        if target is None:
898	            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + target_id)
899	        if source["status"] != "placed":
900	            raise ValueError("only a placed order can transfer a reservation: " + source_id)
901	        if target["status"] != "placed":
902	            raise ValueError("only a placed order can receive a reservation: " + target_id)
903	        if source_id == target_id:
904	            raise ValueError("source and target must be different orders")
905	        products = data.get("products", {})
906	        inventory = data.get("inventory", {})
907	        source_ordered = {}
908	        for line in source["lines"]:
909	            source_ordered[line["sku"]] = source_ordered.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
910	        target_ordered = {}
911	        for line in target["lines"]:
912	            target_ordered[line["sku"]] = target_ordered.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
913	        all_reservations = data.get("reservations", {})
914	        source_held = all_reservations.get(source_id, {})
915	        target_held = all_reservations.get(target_id, {})
916	        # Validate every sku against catalog, managed stock, both orders' lines
917	        # and both current balances before touching any record, so a rejected
918	        # transfer leaves reservations and history untouched.
919	        for sku in sorted(requested):
920	            if sku not in products:
921	                raise ValueError("unknown product: " + sku)
922	            if sku not in inventory:
923	                raise ValueError("product is not managed: " + sku)
924	            if sku not in source_ordered or sku not in target_ordered:
925	                raise ValueError("sku must appear in both orders: " + sku)
926	        for sku, quantity in requested.items():
927	            if quantity > source_held.get(sku, 0):
928	                raise ValueError("source reservation is insufficient: " + sku)
929	            if target_held.get(sku, 0) + quantity > target_ordered[sku]:
930	                raise ValueError("target reservation would exceed ordered quantity: " + sku)
931	        # Source decrement and target increment happen together; the total
932	        # reserved per sku is unchanged, so no stock history is recorded.
933	        records = data.setdefault("reservations", {})
934	        source_record = records.setdefault(source_id, {})
935	        target_record = records.setdefault(target_id, {})
936	        result_lines = []
937	        for sku in sorted(requested):
938	            quantity = requested[sku]
939	            source_after = source_record.get(sku, 0) - quantity
940	            target_after = target_record.get(sku, 0) + quantity
941	            if source_after:
942	                source_record[sku] = source_after
943	            else:
944	                source_record.pop(sku, None)
945	            target_record[sku] = target_after
946	            result_lines.append({
947	                "sku": sku,
948	                "quantity": quantity,
949	                "source_reserved": source_after,
950	                "target_reserved": target_after,
951	            })
952	        if not source_record:
953	            records.pop(source_id, None)
954	        result = {"source_id": source_id, "target_id": target_id, "lines": result_lines}
955	        # Both orders keep the same full snapshot; each continues its own
956	        # sequence and legacy orders start at 1 with complete=False.
957	        self._record_event(data, source_id, "transfer-reservation", result, False)
958	        self._record_event(data, target_id, "transfer-reservation", result, False)
959	        self._write(data)
960	        return result

1034	    def merge_orders(self, source_id, target_id):
1035	        # Merge two placed orders into the target: the source keeps its id,
1036	        # lines and amounts but becomes cancelled, while the target keeps its
1037	        # id and placed status, appends the source's deal lines after its own
1038	        # (line order, duplicate skus, quantities, deal prices and subtotals
1039	        # preserved, never repriced against the catalog) and totals the two
1040	        # original amounts. Repricing, paused sales or a missing catalog entry
1041	        # never block a merge, and zero-price lines are kept. Per sku the
1042	        # source's actual reservations move to the target and the source's
1043	        # attribution is removed: on_hand, total reserved, availability and
1044	        # every other order's reservations never change, shortfalls are never
1045	        # topped up, unmanaged products are never auto-managed and read as
1046	        # zero reservation, and missing inventory/reservation collections or a
1047	        # missing own attribution read as empty. Everything is validated
1048	        # before any mutation, so a rejected merge leaves the file, sequences
1049	        # and every record untouched and never creates the data directory.
1050	        source_id = text(source_id, "source_id")
1051	        target_id = text(target_id, "target_id")
1052	        data = self._read()
1053	        orders = data.get("orders", {})
1054	        source = orders.get(source_id)
1055	        if source is None:
1056	            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + source_id)
1057	        target = orders.get(target_id)
1058	        if target is None:
1059	            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + target_id)
1060	        if source["status"] != "placed":
1061	            raise ValueError("only a placed order can be merged away: " + source_id)
1062	        if target["status"] != "placed":
1063	            raise ValueError("only a placed order can receive a merge: " + target_id)
1064	        if source_id == target_id:
1065	            raise ValueError("source and target must be different orders")
1066	        # Every stored deal price on both orders must be a nonnegative integer
1067	        # (booleans rejected), and one sku's rows must agree on a single deal
1068	        # price across the merged lines -- the catalog price is never
1069	        # consulted and no row is picked as a substitute.
1070	        merged_prices = {}
1071	        for order in (source, target):
1072	            for line in order["lines"]:
1073	                sku = line["sku"]
1074	                unit_price = line.get("unit_price_cents")
1075	                if type(unit_price) is not int or unit_price < 0:
1076	                    raise ValueError("stored unit price is missing or invalid: " + sku)
1077	                if sku in merged_prices and merged_prices[sku] != unit_price:
1078	                    raise ValueError("inconsistent unit prices in merged order: " + sku)
1079	                merged_prices[sku] = unit_price
1080	        # Move the source's actual reservations to the target per sku. Only
1081	        # managed products hold reservations; stray attribution for an
1082	        # unmanaged product reads as zero and disappears with the source's
1083	        # attribution. The total reserved per sku is unchanged, so no stock
1084	        # history is recorded.
1085	        inventory = data.get("inventory", {})
1086	        records = data.get("reservations", {})
1087	        source_held = records.pop(source_id, {})
1088	        moved = {}
1089	        for sku, quantity in source_held.items():
1090	            if sku in inventory and quantity:
1091	                moved[sku] = moved.get(sku, 0) + quantity
1092	        if moved:
1093	            target_record = data.setdefault("reservations", {}).setdefault(target_id, {})
1094	            for sku, quantity in moved.items():
1095	                target_record[sku] = target_record.get(sku, 0) + quantity
1096	        target["lines"] = target["lines"] + copy.deepcopy(source["lines"])
1097	        target["total_cents"] = target["total_cents"] + source["total_cents"]
1098	        source["status"] = "cancelled"
1099	        result = {"source": source, "target": target}
1100	        # Both orders keep the same full snapshot; each continues its own
1101	        # sequence and legacy orders start at 1 with complete=False.
1102	        self._record_event(data, source_id, "merge-orders", result, False)
1103	        self._record_event(data, target_id, "merge-orders", result, False)
1104	        self._write(data)

1918	        others = {}
1919	        for other in data.get("returns", {}).get(order_id, []):
1920	            if other is record:

1922	            for line in other["lines"]:
1923	                others[line["sku"]] = others.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]

2116	            (data.get("returns", {}), False),

import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from order_desk import OrderDesk

class MergeOrdersTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.app = OrderDesk(self.root)
        self.app.add_product("T", "Tea", 100)
        self.app.add_product("C", "Coffee", 200)
        self.app.add_product("U", "Unmanaged", 50)

    def _managed_pair(self):
        # S holds T:2 and C:1, G holds T:3; every product is managed.
        self.app.restock("T", 10)
        self.app.restock("C", 10)
        self.app.place("S", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 2}, {"sku": "C", "quantity": 1}])
        self.app.place("G", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 3}])

    def _write_orders(self, source_lines, target_lines):
        data = {
            "products": {"T": {"sku": "T", "name": "Tea", "price_cents": 100}},
            "orders": {
                "S": {"order_id": "S", "status": "placed", "lines": source_lines,
                      "total_cents": sum(l.get("subtotal_cents", 0) for l in source_lines)},
                "G": {"order_id": "G", "status": "placed", "lines": target_lines,
                      "total_cents": sum(l.get("subtotal_cents", 0) for l in target_lines)},
            },
        }
        self.app.path.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")

    def test_merges_lines_amounts_and_status(self):
        self._managed_pair()
        result = self.app.merge_orders(" S ", "G")
        self.assertEqual(set(result), {"source", "target"})
        source = result["source"]
        self.assertEqual(source["order_id"], "S")
        self.assertEqual(source["status"], "cancelled")
        # The source keeps its original lines and amounts.
        self.assertEqual(source["lines"], [
            {"sku": "T", "quantity": 2, "unit_price_cents": 100, "subtotal_cents": 200},
            {"sku": "C", "quantity": 1, "unit_price_cents": 200, "subtotal_cents": 200},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(source["total_cents"], 400)
        target = result["target"]
        self.assertEqual(target["order_id"], "G")
        self.assertEqual(target["status"], "placed")
        # Source rows follow the target's own rows; duplicate skus stay split.
        self.assertEqual(target["lines"], [
            {"sku": "T", "quantity": 3, "unit_price_cents": 100, "subtotal_cents": 300},
            {"sku": "T", "quantity": 2, "unit_price_cents": 100, "subtotal_cents": 200},
            {"sku": "C", "quantity": 1, "unit_price_cents": 200, "subtotal_cents": 200},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(target["total_cents"], 700)
        # Both entries follow the full get structure.
        self.assertEqual(result["source"], self.app.get("S"))
        self.assertEqual(result["target"], self.app.get("G"))

    def test_duplicate_rows_and_line_order_preserved(self):
        self.app.place("S", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1},
                             {"sku": "C", "quantity": 1},
                             {"sku": "T", "quantity": 2}])
        self.app.place("G", [{"sku": "C", "quantity": 2}])
        result = self.app.merge_orders("S", "G")
        self.assertEqual([(l["sku"], l["quantity"]) for l in result["target"]["lines"]],
                         [("C", 2), ("T", 1), ("C", 1), ("T", 2)])
        self.assertEqual(result["target"]["total_cents"], 900)

    def test_reservations_move_without_touching_stock(self):
        self._managed_pair()
        self.app.place("H", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}])
        before_t = self.app.stock("T")
        before_c = self.app.stock("C")
        self.app.merge_orders("S", "G")
        # Totals, availability and other orders are untouched.
        self.assertEqual(self.app.stock("T"), before_t)
        self.assertEqual(self.app.stock("C"), before_c)
        data = json.loads(self.app.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.assertNotIn("S", data["reservations"])
        self.assertEqual(data["reservations"]["G"], {"T": 5, "C": 1})
        self.assertEqual(data["reservations"]["H"], {"T": 1})
        # Ownership changed only: no stock history is recorded.
        self.assertEqual([e["action"] for e in self.app.stock_history("T")["events"]],
                         ["restock", "place", "place", "place"])

        self._managed_pair()
        result = self.app.merge_orders("S", "G")
        reopened = OrderDesk(self.root)
        self.assertEqual(reopened.get("S"), result["source"])
        self.assertEqual(reopened.get("G"), result["target"])
        for order_id in ("S", "G"):
            events = reopened.history(order_id)["events"]
            self.assertEqual(events[-1]["action"], "merge-orders")
            self.assertEqual(events[-1]["result"], result)

    def test_cli_success_failure_and_array_independence(self):
        self.app.restock("T", 10)
        self.app.place("X1", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 2}])
        self.app.place("X2", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 3}])
        self.app.place("X3", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}])
        payload = self.root / "merge.json"
        payload.write_text(json.dumps({"source_id": " X1 ", "target_id": "X2"}),
                           encoding="utf-8")
        ok = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "order_desk", "--root", str(self.root),
                             "merge-orders", str(payload)],
                            text=True, capture_output=True)
        self.assertEqual(ok.returncode, 0, ok.stderr)
        value = json.loads(ok.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(set(value), {"source", "target"})
        self.assertEqual(value["source"]["status"], "cancelled")
        self.assertEqual(value["source"]["order_id"], "X1")
        self.assertEqual(value["target"]["total_cents"], 500)
        payload.write_text(json.dumps([
            {"source_id": "X3", "target_id": "X2"},
            {"source_id": "X1", "target_id": "X2"},
        ]), encoding="utf-8")
        run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "order_desk", "--root", str(self.root),
                              "merge-orders", str(payload)],
                             text=True, capture_output=True)
        self.assertEqual(run.returncode, 2, run.stdout)
        reopened = OrderDesk(self.root)
        # The first array item succeeded; the failed second item (source
        # already cancelled) did not roll it back or consume another sequence.
        self.assertEqual([e["action"] for e in reopened.history("X2")["events"]],
                         ["place", "merge-orders", "merge-orders"])
        self.assertEqual(reopened.get("X3")["status"], "cancelled")
        self.assertEqual(reopened.stock("T")["reserved"], 6)

# 订单工作台

维护商品价格、计算订单金额，并保存订单与取消状态。金额使用整数分。

## 运行

需要 Python 3.10 或更新版本，仅使用标准库，无依赖安装步骤。请在本目录运行：

```sh
python3 -m order_desk --root ./state demo
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
```

这是本地命令行程序，不监听网络端口，无账户或密码。`demo` 在指定 root 的临时子目录中读取 examples 样例并演示业务，结束后清理样例状态，不改变现有数据。

## 正常使用

公开 API：`from order_desk import OrderDesk`，然后 `OrderDesk(root)`。每个命令接收可选的 JSON 文件，其对象键与 API 方法参数一致。例如：

```sh
python3 -m order_desk --root ./state add-product examples/products.json
```

JSON 数组会按顺序执行多个独立操作；先前成功操作保留，后续失败不会回滚整批。重跑登记命令遇到已存在的标识会报错。

- `add-product` → `OrderDesk.add_product(...)`。参数名见 `core.py` 的公开方法签名。新建商品默认启用销售（`enabled` 为 `true`），但新建时不在数据中写入 `enabled` 字段；仅在显式切换状态时才保存该字段。
- `set-product-enabled` → `OrderDesk.set_product_enabled(sku, enabled)`。暂停或恢复商品销售，仅返回 `{sku, name, price_cents, enabled}`。`sku` 去除首尾空白后匹配并区分大小写，非字符串、空白值或未知商品抛出 `ValueError`；`enabled` 必须是布尔值（`type` 为 `bool`），整数、字符串等不转换为布尔值，否则抛出 `ValueError`。结果与商品同次保存在 `root/data.json`，重新打开一致；重复设置同一状态仍成功；不改变名称、价格、库存、已有订单与历史，也不追加任何订单事件。旧商品缺少 `enabled` 字段时视为启用，设置时才写入该字段。
- `get-product` → `OrderDesk.get_product(sku)`。按 sku 查询商品，仅返回 `{sku, name, price_cents, enabled}`；缺少 `enabled` 字段的旧商品返回 `enabled` 为 `true`，但不补写字段。`sku` 规则同 `set-product-enabled`，非字符串、空白值或未知商品抛出 `ValueError`；查询不创建目录或文件。

- `reprice-products` → `OrderDesk.reprice_products(lines)`。带原价核对的整批调价，一笔请求全部成功或全部拒绝。`lines` 为非空列表，每项是含 `sku`、`expected_price_cents`、`price_cents` 的对象（行内额外字段忽略）：`sku` 为去除首尾空白后的非空字符串，区分大小写；两个价格只接受非负整数分（零价有效），不接受布尔值、字符串或小数。列表类型不符或为空、项目非对象、缺少必要字段、编号非法或未知、价格非法、归一化后编号重复（即使新旧价格都相同也拒绝）、或预期单价与当前目录不符均抛出 `ValueError`。暂停销售和未纳管商品也允许调价，不因此恢复销售或自动纳管；名称、销售状态、库存与预留均不变，旧商品缺少 `enabled` 时仍视为启用且不补写该字段；不新增订单或库存历史、不消耗序号。整批未变价（全部目标价等于原价）时成功但不写文件，也不创建原本不存在的目录；末项失败同样不保留前项变更，文件内容不变。成功返回按 sku 升序的数组，每项仅含 `sku`、`before`、`after`，后两项采用 `get-product` 的完整商品结构，分别反映调价前后的值；目标价等于原价的商品仍返回。有实际变价时整批价格同次保存至 `root/data.json`，重新打开同一 root 后查询一致。调价只影响之后的计价：随后的 `quote`、新下单和购物清单结算按最新目录计价，已保存清单的商品与数量不变；既有订单的商品行、单价、金额及全部历史快照不随调价变化，随后调用 `amend` 仍按其现有规则以提交时目录重算全部商品行，不因原价核对增加限制（商品从 100 分调至 150 分后，原两件订单仍为 200 分，新订单或结算两件为 300 分，原订单成功改为两件后也为 300 分）。
- `restock` → `OrderDesk.restock(sku, quantity)`。补货只增加在库量，不改变预留量；商品首次成功补货后纳管库存。补货不受销售状态影响，暂停商品仍可补货。
- `stock` → `OrderDesk.stock(sku)`。返回 `{sku, on_hand, reserved, available}`；未纳管商品的 `on_hand`、`available` 为 `null`，`reserved` 为 `0`。
- `place` → `OrderDesk.place(...)`。对已纳管商品按合计数量检查并预留可用量（在库量减预留量），任一商品缺货则整笔订单不创建。清单中只要包含一个暂停销售商品（`enabled` 为 `false`，未纳管商品同样适用），整次抛出 `ValueError`，不返回部分预览、不创建订单或预留库存。
- `amend` → `OrderDesk.amend(order_id, lines)`。替换 `placed` 订单的全部商品行，不另建订单，编号与状态不变。`lines` 结构同 `place`，行内额外字段忽略；商品行保留输入顺序与重复 SKU，单价取提交时商品目录，小计与总金额仍为整数分，`get` 与 `list` 返回修改后的内容。同一 SKU 合并数量检查：新需求不得超过当前可用量加该订单实际预留量；成功后各商品预留量等于其他订单预留加本次需求，在库量不变，移除的商品释放其原预留，此后取消或发货只处理修改后的实际预留。未纳管商品仍不限制数量、不生成预留；下单后才纳管的商品按当前库存检查并预留；无预留记录的旧订单不获得额外额度。对暂停销售商品：允许保留、减量或从清单中移除，但不能加入原清单没有的暂停商品，也不能增加该 SKU 的合计数量；比较时分别合并当前订单行与新清单中的重复 SKU，以当前订购量为准，不使用历史数量或实际预留量（原两行合计三件时重排为三件可通过、四件被拒绝；先减为一件后不能再增至两件）。订单不存在或非 `placed`、编号或 SKU 非法、清单非列表或为空、行非对象或缺少 `sku`/`quantity`、数量非正整数或为布尔值、商品未知、库存不足均抛出 `ValueError`，拒绝不改写数据、不消耗历史序号。每次成功提交（含相同清单重复提交）追加 `action` 为 `amend`、`result` 为修改后订单快照的历史事件，旧事件与 `complete` 不变，无历史的旧订单从 1 开始且 `complete` 为 `false`；修改与历史同次写入 `root/data.json`。
- `reduce-order` → `OrderDesk.reduce_order(order_id, lines)`。保留成交价的待发货订单减量，与 `amend` 并列：`amend` 仍按提交时目录重算全部商品行，本命令只按本次减少量扣减现有商品行，不另建订单，编号与 `placed` 状态不变。`order_id` 为去除首尾空白后的非空字符串（区分大小写）；`lines` 为本次减少量的非空列表，每行是含 `sku`、`quantity` 的对象（行内额外字段忽略），`sku` 为去除首尾空白后的非空字符串、区分大小写，`quantity` 只接受正整数且排除布尔值，重复 SKU 合并数量。成功返回与 `get` 相同的完整订单。剩余行保留原有相对顺序和各行成交单价，同一 SKU 从最后一行向前扣减，零数量行移除，剩余重复行不合并；小计按原单价重算，总额仍为整数分，零价商品保留（同一 SKU 原有两行各两件、本次减少三件后只留下第一行一件）。停售、目录缺少商品或库存不足不阻止原订单商品减量；编号非法、订单未知或状态不符、列表或行格式错误、缺字段、SKU 或数量非法、SKU 不属当前订单、合并减少量超量或减完后整单为空，均抛出 `ValueError`；整单取消继续用 `cancel`。失败不写文件、不建目录、不保留部分变更或消耗序号，重复请求按当前数量判断。涉及商品的本单预留变为原实际预留与剩余合计数量的较小值，只释放差额：商品总预留等量减少、可用量等量增加，在库量和其他订单预留不变，未涉及商品不变；缺少库存或本单预留记录时按无预留处理，不自动纳管或补齐，归零的预留归属移除。成功将订单、预留和历史同次保存到 `root/data.json`，重开结果一致：订单追加 `action` 为 `reduce-order`、`result` 为完整返回快照的事件；仅实际释放预留的商品追加同名库存事件，`reference_id` 为订单编号；序号接续，旧快照和 `complete` 保留，无历史的旧数据从 1 开始且 `complete` 为 `false`，不补造过去。减量后现有订单、履约和拣货查询反映剩余内容，取消或发货只处理剩余实际预留，退货以剩余订购量为上限。命令沿用 JSON 输出、错误退出码和外层数组逐项独立执行的约定。
- `reserve-order` → `OrderDesk.reserve_order(order_id)`。为下单时尚未纳管的商品补齐订单预留，保留成交内容：仅处理 `placed` 订单，商品行顺序、重复行、成交单价、金额与状态均不变，暂停销售不阻止补齐。`order_id` 为去除首尾空白后的非空字符串（区分大小写）；未知订单、非法编号、非 `placed` 状态或订单商品不在当前目录中均抛出 `ValueError`。按当前商品行合并重复 SKU 计算需求；对已纳管商品按需求减本单实际预留量的非负差额增加预留（缺少预留记录视为零），仅使用当前可用量，任一商品不足则整笔抛出 `ValueError`，不补齐任何商品；未纳管商品不限制数量、不自动纳管，预留仍为零，在库量和其他订单预留不变。返回仅含 `order_id` 和 `lines`，商品行按 SKU 升序覆盖订单全部商品，每行仅含 `sku`、`quantity`、`added`、`reserved`，分别表示编号、合并需求、新增预留量和补齐后本单预留量，未纳管行后两项为零。实际新增预留时，变更与历史同次保存到 `root/data.json`，重新打开一致：订单历史追加 `action` 为 `reserve-order`、`result` 为返回快照的事件，各新增预留商品按既有库存历史结构记录同名 `action`，`reference_id` 为订单编号，前后快照反映预留与可用量变化，序号接续，旧快照与已有 `complete` 不变，缺少历史的旧数据从 1 开始且 `complete` 为 `false`，不补造过去。没有新增量时仍返回结果，但不写文件或追加事件；失败不写文件、不创建目录或消耗序号。补齐后的拣货汇总、改单、取消和单笔及批量发货按原规则使用实际预留。
- `reserve-batch` → `OrderDesk.reserve_batch(order_ids)`。按优先顺序批量执行预留补齐：`order_ids` 的输入顺序即优先级（编号去除首尾空白后区分大小写），逐单判断并执行，规则与 `reservation-plan` 的预览一致，但可补齐的订单会真实新增预留。`order_ids` 为非空列表，归一化后重复编号、类型不符、编号非法（非字符串或空白）、未知订单、状态非 `placed` 或任一订单商品不在当前目录中均使整次请求抛出 `ValueError`：即使问题在末项也不保留前项变更，不改写文件、不创建目录或消耗历史序号。按各订单当前商品行合并重复 SKU，以需求减本单实际预留的非负差额补齐（缺少预留记录视为零），仅使用扣除全部既有预留后的可用量，不释放或转移既有预留；每单全部纳管商品够量才新增，任一不足就整单跳过并继续后续订单，被跳过订单不占用余量；未纳管商品不限制需求、不自动纳管，暂停销售不阻止补齐。结果按输入顺序返回数组，每项仅含 `order_id`、`can_reserve`、`lines`；`can_reserve` 为能否整单补齐的布尔值，已足额订单也为 `true`。商品行沿用 `reserve-order` 的覆盖范围与 SKU 升序规则，每行仅含 `sku`、`quantity`、`added`、`reserved`、`shortfall`：`added` 为实际新增量，`reserved` 为处理后的本单预留，`shortfall` 为轮到本单时新增需求超出可用量的非负差额；被跳过订单各行 `added` 为零，未纳管行 `added`、`reserved`、`shortfall` 均为零。有新增时将整个批次的变更与历史同次保存到 `root/data.json`，重新打开一致；无新增时不写文件或追加事件。有新增量的订单追加 `action` 为 `reserve-order`、`result` 为单笔补齐返回结构（仅含 `order_id`、`lines`，行内无 `shortfall`）的历史事件，各新增预留商品按既有库存历史结构记录同名 `action`，`reference_id` 为订单编号，共用商品的快照按请求顺序衔接，序号接续，旧快照与已有 `complete` 不变，无历史的旧数据从 1 开始且 `complete` 为 `false`，不补造过去。订单状态、成交行、金额、在库量和本批之外订单的预留不变；补齐后的拣货汇总、改单、取消及发货按原规则使用实际预留。命令外层 JSON 数组继续逐项独立执行，前项成功不因后项失败回滚；整批一致性只限单个 `order_ids` 请求。
- `quote` → `OrderDesk.quote(lines)`。下单前预览，不创建订单、不预留库存、不写任何文件。`lines` 为非空列表，每行含 `sku`（去除首尾空白后非空字符串，区分大小写）和正整数 `quantity`（不接受布尔值），行内额外字段忽略；清单非列表或为空、行不是对象、缺少必要字段、sku 非法、数量为零/负数/非整数、商品不存在均抛出 `ValueError`，整次预览不返回部分结果。清单中只要包含一个暂停销售商品（含未纳管商品）即整次抛出 `ValueError`。相同 sku 合并数量，商品行按 sku 升序；返回仅含 `lines`、`total_cents`、`can_place`，每行仅含 `sku`、`quantity`、`unit_price_cents`、`subtotal_cents`、`available`、`shortfall`。单价只取当前目录，小计为合并数量乘单价，缺货商品和零价商品都保留。纳管商品 `available` 为在库量减预留量，`shortfall` 为需求超过可用量的部分（未超过为零）；未纳管商品（含无库存字段的旧数据）`available` 为 `null`、`shortfall` 为零。所有行缺口为零时 `can_place` 为 `true`。预览不锁定价格或库存，随后交给 `place` 时仍按当时数据校验和预留。恢复启用后，`quote`、`place`、`amend` 恢复既有规则。
- `get` → `OrderDesk.get(...)`。参数名见 `core.py` 的公开方法签名。
- `save-cart` → `OrderDesk.save_cart(cart_id, lines)`。保存可稍后结算的购物清单，关闭工作台后仍可继续处理。`cart_id` 为去除首尾空白后的非空字符串（区分大小写），与订单编号互不占用；新编号创建清单，同一编号再次保存完整替换。`lines` 为非空列表，每行含 `sku`（规则同 `quote`）和正整数 `quantity`（不接受布尔值），行内额外字段忽略；重复 SKU 合并数量，商品行按 SKU 升序。返回仅含 `cart_id`、`lines`，每行仅含 `sku`、`quantity`。清单非列表或为空、行非对象或缺少 `sku`/`quantity`、SKU 非法、数量非正整数或为布尔值、商品不存在、清单编号非法均抛出 `ValueError`，失败不创建或改写清单。暂停销售和库存不足的商品可以保存；保存不记录价格、不预留库存、不创建订单或历史。清单随业务数据保存在 `root/data.json`，重新打开同一 root 后未结算清单仍可查询。
- `cart` → `OrderDesk.get_cart(cart_id)`。查询已保存的清单，返回仅含 `cart_id`、`lines`（每行仅含 `sku`、`quantity`）。`cart_id` 非法或清单不存在均抛出 `ValueError`；查询不创建目录或文件。旧数据缺少清单时视为空集合，不补造记录。

62:- `history` → `OrderDesk.history(order_id)`。按实际发生顺序返回订单过程，仅含 `order_id`、`status`、`complete`、`events`：`status` 为订单当前状态；`complete` 表示历史是否包含真实创建事件。`events` 按成功操作先后排列，每项仅含 `sequence`、`action`、`result`；`sequence` 在每个订单内从 1 连续递增，`action` 为 `place`、`amend`、`reduce-order`、`reserve-order`、`transfer-reservation`、`release-reservation`、`cancel`、`reopen-order`、`ship`、`confirm-delivery`、`correct-shipment`、`record-return`、`receive-return`、`cancel-return`、`amend-return`、`cancel-received-return`，`result` 保存对应公开方法成功返回内容的快照（创建保留成交商品行与金额，发货保留 shipment，签收保留含 delivery 的完整订单，发货更正仅保留前后 shipment 快照，退货保留归并后的记录，入库保留各行入库前后库存快照，撤销保留原登记的归并记录，退货更正保留前后归并清单），后续操作不改写旧快照。操作失败不新增事件、不消耗序号；退货编号即使逆序提交，历史仍按登记顺序显示。历史随业务数据保存在 `root/data.json`，与业务变更同次写入，重新打开同一 root 结果一致。无历史数据的旧订单查询时 `events` 为空、`complete` 为 `false`，不依据状态或已有退货记录补造；这类订单随后成功取消、发货或登记退货时从 1 开始记录新事件，`complete` 仍为 `false`，新创建订单为 `true`。`order_id` 须为去除首尾空白后的非空字符串（区分大小写），非字符串、空白编号及未知订单均抛出 `ValueError`；查询不创建目录或写文件。
72:- `stock-history` → `OrderDesk.stock_history(sku)`。按商品追溯在库量与预留量的变动，仅返回 `{sku, complete, events}`：`complete` 表示历史是否覆盖首次纳管以来的全部变动。`events` 按成功变动先后排列，`sequence` 在该商品内从 1 连续递增，每项仅含 `sequence`、`action`、`reference_id`、`before`、`after`；`before` 与 `after` 沿用 stock 的完整库存结构（`{sku, on_hand, reserved, available}`）。补货、下单、改单、待发货订单减量、预留补齐、预留释放、取消、恢复、发货、退货入库、入库冲销、盘点和盘点撤销在成功改变在库量或预留量时各记录一条事件，`action` 为对应单笔命令名（`restock`、`place`、`amend`、`reduce-order`、`reserve-order`、`release-reservation`、`cancel`、`reopen-order`、`ship`、`receive-return`、`cancel-received-return`、`count-stock`、`reverse-stock-count`），购物清单结算记为 `place`，批量发货记为 `ship`；`reference_id` 在补货时为 `null`，下单、改单、订单减量、预留补齐、预留释放、取消、恢复、发货时为订单编号，退货入库、入库冲销、盘点和盘点撤销时为退货编号和盘点编号。批量发货按请求内订单顺序逐笔记录，共用商品的快照连续衔接；改单每个 SKU 仅记录最终净变化，不记录临时释放与预留；同值盘点、净库存不变的改单及没有实际预留的取消或发货均不新增事件，既有业务结果与订单历史照常产生。首次补货从未纳管变为纳管也算变化，其 `before` 为 stock 的未纳管结果；暂停销售不影响记录规则。事件与业务变更同次保存在 `root/data.json`，重新打开结果一致，后续操作不改写旧快照；操作失败不新增事件或消耗序号，整批发货拒绝时也不留下事件。尚未纳管的商品返回 `complete` 为 `true` 的空历史；已纳管但缺少历史的旧商品返回 `complete` 为 `false` 和空事件，后续事件从 1 开始且 `complete` 一直为 `false`，不从已有订单或盘点补造过程。`sku` 去除首尾空白后匹配并区分大小写，非字符串、空白值或未知商品均抛出 `ValueError`；查询不创建目录或写文件。
78:- `merge-orders` → `OrderDesk.merge_orders(source_id, target_id)`。把两笔待发货订单合并为一笔：来源订单改为 `cancelled`，保留原编号、商品行和金额；目标订单保留编号及 `placed` 状态，把来源商品行接在原有行之后，保留行序、重复 SKU、数量、成交单价和小计，总额为两单原金额之和。调价、暂停销售或目录缺少商品均不阻止合并，零价行保留。两个编号均为去除首尾空白后的非空字符串（区分大小写）且必须不同；编号非法、同单合并、订单未知或任一单非 `placed` 均抛出 `ValueError`。任一商品行的成交单价缺失、为负数、非整数或布尔值，以及合并后同一 SKU 各行成交单价不一致，均整次抛出 `ValueError`，不取目录价格或任选一行替代。预留按 SKU 把两单实际预留相加归给目标并移除来源归属：各商品在库量、总预留量、可用量及其他订单预留不变，不补齐缺口；未纳管商品不自动纳管，其预留按零处理；缺少库存或预留集合时沿用空集合语义，本单归属缺失按零处理。请求整体成功或拒绝：失败不改写文件、不创建目录、不保留部分变更或消耗序号。成功仅返回 `source` 和 `target`，两项沿用 `get` 的完整订单结构；订单、预留和历史同次保存到 `root/data.json`，重新打开一致。两单各追加一条 `action` 为 `merge-orders`、`result` 为完整返回快照的事件，序号各自接续，旧快照与已有 `complete` 保留，无历史的旧订单从 1 开始且 `complete` 为 `false`，不补造过去，不新增库存事件。购物清单、其他订单和退货记录保持原样。合并后拣货、履约和预留查询显示合并后的内容，后续改单、补齐、取消和发货继续按既有规则处理，来源仍可通过 `reopen-order` 恢复；重复请求因来源已取消而抛出 `ValueError`。命令外层 JSON 数组继续逐项独立执行，前项成功不因后项失败回滚。

Install
python3 --version
需要 Python 3.10+，仅标准库，无需下载依赖。

Start
python3 -m order_desk --root ./state demo
输出一份 JSON 业务结果；演示使用临时样例目录。无需端口或账户。

Smoke Test
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
执行 API、持久化、错误路径和 CLI 检查；最终应为 OK。

Now I have a full picture. Let me design `split_order(source_id, target_id, lines)`:

Requirements recap:
- `OrderDesk.split_order(source_id, target_id, lines)` + `split-order` CLI command.
- Move specified quantities from source order into a NEW order with id target_id.
- IDs: trimmed nonempty strings, case-sensitive.
- lines: nonempty list; each line object with sku and quantity; quantity positive non-bool int; extra fields ignored; duplicate SKUs merged.

import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from order_desk import OrderDesk

class SplitOrderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.app = OrderDesk(self.root)
        self.app.add_product("T", "Tea", 100)
        self.app.add_product("C", "Coffee", 200)
        self.app.add_product("U", "Unmanaged", 50)

    def _managed_source(self):
        # S holds T:4 and C:2 with full reservations; every product managed.
        self.app.restock("T", 10)
        self.app.restock("C", 10)
        self.app.place("S", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 4}, {"sku": "C", "quantity": 2}])

    def _write_source(self, source_lines, extra=None):
        data = {
            "products": {"T": {"sku": "T", "name": "Tea", "price_cents": 100}},
            "orders": {
                "S": {"order_id": "S", "status": "placed", "lines": source_lines,
                      "total_cents": sum(l.get("subtotal_cents", 0) for l in source_lines)},
            },
        }
        if extra:
            data.update(extra)
        self.app.path.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")

    def test_splits_lines_amounts_and_status(self):
        self._managed_source()
        result = self.app.split_order(" S ", " N ", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}])
        self.assertEqual(set(result), {"source", "target"})
        source = result["source"]
        self.assertEqual(source["order_id"], "S")
        self.assertEqual(source["status"], "placed")
        self.assertEqual(source["lines"], [
            {"sku": "T", "quantity": 3, "unit_price_cents": 100, "subtotal_cents": 300},
            {"sku": "C", "quantity": 2, "unit_price_cents": 200, "subtotal_cents": 400},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(source["total_cents"], 700)
        target = result["target"]
        self.assertEqual(target["order_id"], "N")
        self.assertEqual(target["status"], "placed")
        self.assertEqual(target["lines"], [
            {"sku": "T", "quantity": 1, "unit_price_cents": 100, "subtotal_cents": 100},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(target["total_cents"], 100)
        # The two totals sum to the original total.
        self.assertEqual(source["total_cents"] + target["total_cents"], 800)
        # Both entries follow the full get structure.
        self.assertEqual(result["source"], self.app.get("S"))
        self.assertEqual(result["target"], self.app.get("N"))

    def test_takes_from_last_row_backwards(self):
        self.app.place("S", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1},
                             {"sku": "C", "quantity": 1},
                             {"sku": "T", "quantity": 3}])
        result = self.app.split_order("S", "N", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 2}])
        # The moved quantity comes off the last T row; both sides keep the
        # original relative row order and duplicates stay split.
        self.assertEqual([(l["sku"], l["quantity"]) for l in result["source"]["lines"]],
                         [("T", 1), ("C", 1), ("T", 1)])
        self.assertEqual([(l["sku"], l["quantity"]) for l in result["target"]["lines"]],
                         [("T", 2)])
        self.assertEqual(result["source"]["total_cents"], 400)
        self.assertEqual(result["target"]["total_cents"], 200)

    def test_duplicate_request_lines_merge(self):
        self.app.place("S", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 3}])
        result = self.app.split_order("S", "N", [{"sku": " T ", "quantity": 1, "note": "x"},
                                                 {"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}])
        self.assertEqual(result["source"]["lines"][0]["quantity"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(result["target"]["lines"],
                         [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 2, "unit_price_cents": 100,
                           "subtotal_cents": 200}])

    def test_zero_price_rows_are_kept(self):
        self.app.add_product("Z", "Free", 0)
        self.app.place("S", [{"sku": "Z", "quantity": 2}, {"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}])
        result = self.app.split_order("S", "N", [{"sku": "Z", "quantity": 1}])
        self.assertEqual(result["target"]["lines"],
                         [{"sku": "Z", "quantity": 1, "unit_price_cents": 0,
                           "subtotal_cents": 0}])
        self.assertEqual(result["target"]["total_cents"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(result["source"]["total_cents"], 100)

    def test_input_validation(self):
        self._managed_source()
        bad_payloads = [
            {"source_id": "  ", "target_id": "N", "lines": [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}]},
            {"source_id": 1, "target_id": "N", "lines": [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}]},
            {"source_id": None, "target_id": "N", "lines": [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}]},
            {"source_id": "S", "target_id": "", "lines": [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}]},
            {"source_id": "S", "target_id": "  ", "lines": [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}]},
            {"source_id": "S", "target_id": 2, "lines": [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}]},
            {"source_id": "S", "target_id": "S", "lines": [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}]},
            {"source_id": " S ", "target_id": "S", "lines": [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}]},
            {"source_id": "nope", "target_id": "N", "lines": [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}]},
            # Ids are trimmed and case sensitive.
            {"source_id": "s", "target_id": "N", "lines": [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}]},
            {"source_id": "S", "target_id": "N", "lines": []},
            {"source_id": "S", "target_id": "N", "lines": "T"},
            {"source_id": "S", "target_id": "N", "lines": ["T"]},
            {"source_id": "S", "target_id": "N", "lines": [{"sku": "T"}]},
            {"source_id": "S", "target_id": "N", "lines": [{"quantity": 1}]},
            {"source_id": "S", "target_id": "N", "lines": [{"sku": " ", "quantity": 1}]},
            {"source_id": "S", "target_id": "N", "lines": [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 0}]},
            {"source_id": "S", "target_id": "N", "lines": [{"sku": "T", "quantity": -1}]},
            {"source_id": "S", "target_id": "N", "lines": [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1.5}]},
            {"source_id": "S", "target_id": "N", "lines": [{"sku": "T", "quantity": True}]},
            {"source_id": "S", "target_id": "N", "lines": [{"sku": "T", "quantity": "1"}]},
            # Sku matching is case sensitive.
            {"source_id": "S", "target_id": "N", "lines": [{"sku": "t", "quantity": 1}]},
            {"source_id": "S", "target_id": "N", "lines": [{"sku": "X", "quantity": 1}]},
            # Merged quantity exceeds the ordered quantity.
            {"source_id": "S", "target_id": "N", "lines": [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 5}]},
            {"source_id": "S", "target_id": "N",
             "lines": [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 3}, {"sku": "T", "quantity": 2}]},
            # Moving the whole order away is rejected.
            {"source_id": "S", "target_id": "N",
             "lines": [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 4}, {"sku": "C", "quantity": 2}]},
        ]
        for payload in bad_payloads:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError, msg=payload):
                self.app.split_order(**payload)
        # An occupied target id is rejected, even of a cancelled order.
        self.app.place("G", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.app.split_order("S", "G", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}])
        self.app.cancel("G")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.app.split_order("S", "G", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}])
        # A non-placed source cannot be split.
        self.app.cancel("S")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.app.split_order("S", "N", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}])

    def test_deal_price_validation(self):
        bad_lines = [
            {"sku": "T", "quantity": 1, "subtotal_cents": 100},
            {"sku": "T", "quantity": 1, "unit_price_cents": None, "subtotal_cents": 100},
            {"sku": "T", "quantity": 1, "unit_price_cents": -1, "subtotal_cents": -1},
            {"sku": "T", "quantity": 1, "unit_price_cents": 1.5, "subtotal_cents": 1},
            {"sku": "T", "quantity": 1, "unit_price_cents": True, "subtotal_cents": 1},
            {"sku": "T", "quantity": 1, "unit_price_cents": "100", "subtotal_cents": 100},
        ]
        for bad in bad_lines:
            self._write_source([bad, {"sku": "T", "quantity": 1, "unit_price_cents": 100,
                                      "subtotal_cents": 100}])
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError, msg=bad):
                self.app.split_order("S", "N", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}])
        # Inconsistent deal prices inside the source's own rows reject too.
        self._write_source([
            {"sku": "T", "quantity": 1, "unit_price_cents": 100, "subtotal_cents": 100},
            {"sku": "T", "quantity": 2, "unit_price_cents": 150, "subtotal_cents": 300},
        ])
        raw = self.app.path.read_bytes()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.app.split_order("S", "N", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}])
        self.assertEqual(self.app.path.read_bytes(), raw)

    def test_paused_repriced_catalog_missing_and_short_stock_do_not_block(self):
        self.app.place("S", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 2}, {"sku": "C", "quantity": 1}])
        self.app.set_product_enabled("T", False)
        self.app.reprice_products([{"sku": "C", "expected_price_cents": 200, "price_cents": 250}])
        result = self.app.split_order("S", "N", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1},
                                                 {"sku": "C", "quantity": 1}])
        # Deal prices are preserved, never repriced against the catalog.
        self.assertEqual(result["target"]["lines"], [
            {"sku": "T", "quantity": 1, "unit_price_cents": 100, "subtotal_cents": 100},
            {"sku": "C", "quantity": 1, "unit_price_cents": 200, "subtotal_cents": 200},
        ])
        # A product missing from the catalog does not block the split either.
        data = json.loads(self.app.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        del data["products"]["T"]
        self.app.path.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")
        moved = self.app.split_order("S", "M", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}])
        self.assertEqual(moved["target"]["status"], "placed")
        self.assertEqual(moved["target"]["lines"][0]["unit_price_cents"], 100)

import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from order_desk import OrderDesk

class SplitOrderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.app = OrderDesk(self.root)
        self.app.add_product("T", "Tea", 100)
        self.app.add_product("C", "Coffee", 200)
        self.app.add_product("U", "Unmanaged", 50)

    def _managed_source(self):
        # S holds T:4 and C:2 with full reservations; every product managed.
        self.app.restock("T", 10)
        self.app.restock("C", 10)
        self.app.place("S", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 4}, {"sku": "C", "quantity": 2}])

    def _write_source(self, source_lines, extra=None):
        data = {
            "products": {"T": {"sku": "T", "name": "Tea", "price_cents": 100}},
            "orders": {
                "S": {"order_id": "S", "status": "placed", "lines": source_lines,
                      "total_cents": sum(l.get("subtotal_cents", 0) for l in source_lines)},
            },
        }
        if extra:
            data.update(extra)
        self.app.path.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")

    def test_splits_lines_amounts_and_status(self):
        self._managed_source()
        result = self.app.split_order(" S ", " N ", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}])
        self.assertEqual(set(result), {"source", "target"})
        source = result["source"]
        self.assertEqual(source["order_id"], "S")
        self.assertEqual(source["status"], "placed")
        self.assertEqual(source["lines"], [
            {"sku": "T", "quantity": 3, "unit_price_cents": 100, "subtotal_cents": 300},
            {"sku": "C", "quantity": 2, "unit_price_cents": 200, "subtotal_cents": 400},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(source["total_cents"], 700)
        target = result["target"]
        self.assertEqual(target["order_id"], "N")
        self.assertEqual(target["status"], "placed")
        self.assertEqual(target["lines"], [
            {"sku": "T", "quantity": 1, "unit_price_cents": 100, "subtotal_cents": 100},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(target["total_cents"], 100)
        # The two totals sum to the original total.
        self.assertEqual(source["total_cents"] + target["total_cents"], 800)
        # Both entries follow the full get structure.
        self.assertEqual(result["source"], self.app.get("S"))
        self.assertEqual(result["target"], self.app.get("N"))

    def test_takes_from_last_row_backwards(self):
        self.app.place("S", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1},
                             {"sku": "C", "quantity": 1},
                             {"sku": "T", "quantity": 3}])
        result = self.app.split_order("S", "N", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 2}])
        # The moved quantity comes off the last T row; both sides keep the
        # original relative row order and duplicates stay split.
        self.assertEqual([(l["sku"], l["quantity"]) for l in result["source"]["lines"]],
                         [("T", 1), ("C", 1), ("T", 1)])
        self.assertEqual([(l["sku"], l["quantity"]) for l in result["target"]["lines"]],
                         [("T", 2)])
        self.assertEqual(result["source"]["total_cents"], 400)
        self.assertEqual(result["target"]["total_cents"], 200)

    def test_duplicate_request_lines_merge(self):
        self.app.place("S", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 3}])
        result = self.app.split_order("S", "N", [{"sku": " T ", "quantity": 1, "note": "x"},
                                                 {"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}])
        self.assertEqual(result["source"]["lines"][0]["quantity"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(result["target"]["lines"],

    def test_input_validation(self):
        self._managed_source()
        bad_payloads = [
            {"source_id": "  ", "target_id": "N", "lines": [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}]},
            {"source_id": 1, "target_id": "N", "lines": [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}]},

            {"source_id": "S", "target_id": "N", "lines": [{"sku": "T", "quantity": "1"}]},
            # Sku matching is case sensitive.
            {"source_id": "S", "target_id": "N", "lines": [{"sku": "t", "quantity": 1}]},
            {"source_id": "S", "target_id": "N", "lines": [{"sku": "X", "quantity": 1}]},
            # Merged quantity exceeds the ordered quantity.
            {"source_id": "S", "target_id": "N", "lines": [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 5}]},
            {"source_id": "S", "target_id": "N",
             "lines": [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 3}, {"sku": "T", "quantity": 2}]},

        self.app.cancel("S")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.app.split_order("S", "N", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}])

    def test_deal_price_validation(self):
        bad_lines = [

    def test_paused_repriced_catalog_missing_and_short_stock_do_not_block(self):
        self.app.place("S", [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 2}, {"sku": "C", "quantity": 1}])

    def test_cli_success_failure_and_array_independence(self):
        self.app.restock("T", 10)

                                       "lines": [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}]}),
                           encoding="utf-8")
        ok = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "order_desk", "--root", str(self.root),
                             "split-order", str(payload)],
                            text=True, capture_output=True)
        self.assertEqual(ok.returncode, 0, ok.stderr)
        value = json.loads(ok.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(set(value), {"source", "target"})
        self.assertEqual(value["source"]["order_id"], "X1")
        self.assertEqual(value["source"]["total_cents"], 300)
        self.assertEqual(value["target"]["order_id"], "X2")
        self.assertEqual(value["target"]["total_cents"], 100)
        payload.write_text(json.dumps([
            {"source_id": "X1", "target_id": "X3", "lines": [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}]},
            {"source_id": "X1", "target_id": "X3", "lines": [{"sku": "T", "quantity": 1}]},
        ]), encoding="utf-8")
        run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "order_desk", "--root", str(self.root),
                              "split-order", str(payload)],
                             text=True, capture_output=True)
        self.assertEqual(run.returncode, 2, run.stdout)
        reopened = OrderDesk(self.root)
        # The first array item succeeded; the failed second item (target id
        # now occupied) did not roll it back or consume another sequence.
        self.assertEqual([e["action"] for e in reopened.history("X1")["events"]],
                         ["place", "split-order", "split-order"])
        self.assertEqual([e["action"] for e in reopened.history("X3")["events"]],
                         ["split-order"])
        self.assertEqual(reopened.get("X1")["total_cents"], 200)
        self.assertEqual(reopened.stock("T")["reserved"], 4)

62:- `history` → `OrderDesk.history(order_id)`。按实际发生顺序返回订单过程，仅含 `order_id`、`status`、`complete`、`events`：`status` 为订单当前状态；`complete` 表示历史是否包含真实创建事件。`events` 按成功操作先后排列，每项仅含 `sequence`、`action`、`result`；`sequence` 在每个订单内从 1 连续递增，`action` 为 `place`、`amend`、`reduce-order`、`reserve-order`、`transfer-reservation`、`release-reservation`、`cancel`、`reopen-order`、`ship`、`confirm-delivery`、`correct-shipment`、`record-return`、`receive-return`、`cancel-return`、`amend-return`、`cancel-received-return`，`result` 保存对应公开方法成功返回内容的快照（创建保留成交商品行与金额，发货保留 shipment，签收保留含 delivery 的完整订单，发货更正仅保留前后 shipment 快照，退货保留归并后的记录，入库保留各行入库前后库存快照，撤销保留原登记的归并记录，退货更正保留前后归并清单），后续操作不改写旧快照。操作失败不新增事件、不消耗序号；退货编号即使逆序提交，历史仍按登记顺序显示。历史随业务数据保存在 `root/data.json`，与业务变更同次写入，重新打开同一 root 结果一致。无历史数据的旧订单查询时 `events` 为空、`complete` 为 `false`，不依据状态或已有退货记录补造；这类订单随后成功取消、发货或登记退货时从 1 开始记录新事件，`complete` 仍为 `false`，新创建订单为 `true`。`order_id` 须为去除首尾空白后的非空字符串（区分大小写），非字符串、空白编号及未知订单均抛出 `ValueError`；查询不创建目录或写文件。
